title: Proposal Refinement
description: Fork an immutable proposal, finalize a draft into a held committed snapshot, or extend a committed hold into a new committed snapshot. Revising with structured criteria, typed boundaries, product changes, installment changes, requested alternatives, and/or a semantic ask creates one or more new drafts; finalizing and extending a hold change no terms. Refining an accepted proposal creates a draft amendment or cancellation proposal against its MediaBuy; the source remains accepted and unchanged. A revised product mix must support the resulting root frequency cap; because omitted criteria inherit, clearing the cap is explicit through remove_media_buy_frequency_cap.

action.description: revise creates a new draft snapshot with changed commercial terms. finalize MUST target a draft; it creates a new committed snapshot without changing terms and reserves inventory until its expires_at. extend_hold (experimental, media_buy.hold_extension) MUST target a committed, unexpired proposal that holds inventory (one with no hold fails with INVALID_STATE); it creates a new committed successor with the same commercial_terms and terms_digest and a later expires_at, and the hold transfers to it with the source's hold_policy and hold_placed_at carried forward unchanged. Buyers MUST NOT send extend_hold unless the seller declares media_buy.proposal_refinement.hold_extension.

change_kind.description: Desired successor proposal. cancellation is valid only when the source proposal is accepted and attached to a non-terminal MediaBuy.

constraints.description: Hard requirements for every revised proposal. Keys are echoed in unsatisfied_constraints on partial or unable results. A draft that fails any present constraint MUST NOT be returned as revised: the result is partial or unable with reason_code constraint_unsatisfiable — which takes precedence over every other reason code — and the failing keys in unsatisfied_constraints.

total_budget.description: Inclusive bounds checked against commercial_terms.total_budget. Satisfied only when commercial_terms.total_budget is present, its currency matches, and its amount falls within every supplied bound.

cpm.description: Hard ceiling on fixed CPM rates. Satisfied only when every entry of commercial_terms.purchases carries pricing with pricing_model cpm or vcpm, a matching currency, and a fixed_price no greater than max. Auction-priced, missing, or non-CPM pricing on any purchase leaves the constraint unsatisfied.

impressions.description: Hard minimum contracted impression volume. Satisfied only when every entry of commercial_terms.purchases carries impressions and their sum is at least min.

flight.description: Hard flight-window bounds checked against commercial_terms.start_time and end_time. start_no_later_than is satisfied only by a concrete start_time at or before the bound; an asap start is unverifiable and therefore unsatisfied. end_no_earlier_than is satisfied only by an end_time at or after the bound.

product_changes.description: Product IDs mapped to membership actions checked against commercial_terms.purchases. include requires presence; omit requires absence. The verbs match legacy get_products refinement.

installment_changes.description: Experimental (media_buy.installment_refinement). Asks for specific installments of a product. Send it only to a seller that lists media_buy.installment_refinement in experimental_features and installment_changes in media_buy.proposal_refinement.supported_dimensions. A satisfying draft purchases, for each named product, one product whose installments equal the selected set; a different set is a different product_id, so the seller may offer a product derived for the selection in its place. The seller MUST NOT change the installments of a product it has offered. Before finalizing, the buyer compares each selected set with the returned product's installments and rejects a mismatch. An entry MUST NOT name a product that product_changes omits in the same request (INVALID_REQUEST); a product_changes include of a named product is satisfied by the purchase that answers its selection. Nothing in commercial_terms changes: terms_digest binds the purchased product_id as it always has.

alternatives.description: Request drafts with distinct commercial terms by count. Every returned alternative MUST carry distinct commercial_terms and therefore a unique terms_digest; diversity preferences remain in ask.

count.description: Number of draft alternatives requested. The protocol maximum is 10. Buyers MUST NOT exceed a seller's lower advertised proposal_refinement.max_alternatives; sellers reject an excessive count at task level with VALIDATION_ERROR rather than clamping it.

ask.description: What the buyer is asking for on this proposal, or the cancellation reason for action revise. The seller returns a new draft proposal snapshot; this text never directly mutates the source proposal or MediaBuy.

criteria.description: Structured discovery changes for action revise. Each present field replaces that criterion from the source proposal; omitted fields inherit. Concrete targeting, future targeting support, and offer filters belong here rather than being repeated in ask.

remove_media_buy_frequency_cap.description: Request a revised draft whose commercial terms omit the existing MediaBuy frequency cap. Omission inherits it. To replace it, provide criteria.media_buy_frequency_cap instead.
